what_is_seen: A shaky running camera chases a figure along a city pavement at night. Lit shop windows and neon signs run down one side, parked cars and traffic lights line the road on the other, and tall apartment blocks with lit windows stand at the end of the street under a deep blue sky.

transcript: He can carve a big bear out of the wood.
spoken_sentences: He can carve a big bear out of the wood.
what_is_seen: In a wood, a man in a blue T-shirt and work gloves cuts into a standing tree trunk with a chainsaw. A life-size bear is already emerging from the pale wood, and he saws around its shoulders and body, sending a spray of sawdust out to the side while the bark below is cut away to free the bear's legs.

A montage of one young man shifting heavy things. He leans into the back of a small silver car on a suburban street and shoves it along the kerb. Next he is behind a supermarket trolley in a car park, driving it forward across the tarmac. Then he stands behind a child on a playground swing and sends him forward. In a warehouse he braces his shoulder against a huge wooden crate and tips it along the floor, and finally a group of friends put their hands on a giant stone ball on a grassy hill and roll it over the grass.

A woman in a blue t-shirt stands at a white kitchen sink with the tap running hard into the basin. Cut to a workshop, where a woman in dark overalls kneels on a sawdust-covered floor and drives a cordless drill into the leg of a wooden chair. Then a pair of hands on a grey table hold an opened blue phone with its back off, the battery and circuit board exposed. A teenager in a checked shirt leans over the engine bay of an old blue car in a driveway with a spanner, and finally he punches the air and shouts beside the open bonnet.

transcript: There we go. Nice and even. Pretty. Ta-da!
what_is_seen: Close on two hands in a living room stitching a dark button onto the front of a pale blue shirt with a needle. Cut to a workroom where dark hands push a fine needle through the folded hem of a piece of natural linen, with spools of coloured thread on the shelf behind. Then a sewing machine foot runs a line of stitches along a folded cream panel. Next an embroidery hoop holds a big pink and red flower worked in coloured threads with green leaves. Finally a row of people in a hall lift a finished patchwork quilt above their heads and cheer.

transcript: So clean. Got it. Almost there. Looking good.
what_is_seen: A blue spin mop is pushed across beige kitchen tiles, leaving a wet shine between the grout lines. Cut to a woman in a grey shirt bending over a flat mop in a cream-tiled corridor. Then an older woman with white hair drags a wide dust mop down the aisle of a shop between shelves of bottles. Next a woman works a long-handled mop across the vast polished concrete of an empty warehouse, the ceiling lights reflected in it. Finally she sits down on the gleaming warehouse floor with her arms thrown wide.

transcript: In you go. Drink up. Ta-da! Look at that.
what_is_seen: Gloved hands press the soil around a small green seedling just set into a terracotta pot on a patio, with other pots and plants behind. Cut to a watering can pouring a wide spray over a raised bed packed with orange, pink and purple flowers beside a wooden house. Then a woman in gloves closes a pair of red secateurs on a stem inside a tall glossy hedge. Next she bends over a vegetable patch and takes hold of a large orange pumpkin among the broad leaves, and finally she straightens up holding the pumpkin against her chest and grins.

transcript: There you go. Drink up. Up here too.
what_is_seen: A hand tips a metal watering can over two terracotta pots of green herbs on a sunlit window sill, with trees in full leaf outside the open window. Cut to a close shot of a hand turning the knob on a sprinkler head standing in bright green grass. The sprinkler sends a tall jet of water arcing over a lawn with a stone fountain and flower beds behind. Then a girl reaches up to a hanging basket spilling pink and green foliage against a blue sky. Finally a man and two children run through the spray of a garden sprinkler, with a rainbow in the mist.

Over the top of a camera on a tripod, a woman in a striped summer dress stands smiling on a sunlit park lawn under tall trees. Cut to a macro shot of round dew drops beading along a green leaf in a flower bed. Then two hands hold up a black DSLR with a big flash on top and shoot into a sunset over rolling hills, the sun low and orange on the horizon. The same shot holds as the sun drops further. Finally a young man in a straw hat and green shirt turns a big black camera with a long lens towards the viewer at a red-carpet event.

A young man with wild hair and glasses stands at a huge blackboard in a university lecture hall full of students. He writes chalk equations fast, checks a pocket calculator, keeps writing, punches the air, and by the end the entire wall-sized blackboard is filled with mathematics while he stands back in front of it.

A young man in glasses with headphones round his neck sits at a desk holding small word cards. He taps his temple, reads a card, flips it over and drops it, and the cards multiply until the desk is buried and the wall behind him is papered with them.

A young woman works at a laptop in a bright home office and raises one finger asking for quiet as she talks. Behind her a young man slips past the doorway, then another man carries a box through. Then an entire marching band files into the room in matching navy, orange and light blue uniforms, playing trumpets, a trombone, a sousaphone and a bass drum. She throws her hands up and shouts in disbelief while the band plays on around her desk.

transcript: Perfect. Sharp. Got it. Amazing! Yes!
what_is_seen: A young photographer kneels on sunlit grass in a park and aims a big camera with a long lens straight at the viewer. He then crouches in a city garden to photograph a pink rose from close up, skyscrapers behind him. A close shot shows the camera's rear screen with a sunset over a city, the camera sitting on a tripod. The sunset view fills the frame over the tripod. At night on a red carpet in a crowd he lifts the camera and grins.

A man walks through Times Square holding a phone on a gimbal and filming himself. In a film studio a hand holds a clapperboard reading ACTION in front of a cinema camera on a tripod under a large softbox. A white drone with four propellers hovers low over a green field, flattening the grass beneath it. An aerial shot glides over rolling green and yellow farmland. Back in the studio the crew claps and cheers behind a camera operator.

A montage of people making videos. A young man in a gaming chair with a headset shouts happily at a ring light, a lit keyboard in front of him. A woman in a kitchen holds up a big pan of chicken and vegetables toward the camera. A girl on a sofa laughs and holds both thumbs up close to the lens. A young man sings loudly into a studio microphone with an electric guitar. Finally a performer stands on a huge arena stage with arms raised, confetti falling, filmed by two camera operators.

transcript: Aha! Got it! Nice! Almost there... It works!
what_is_seen: A laptop on a desk shows lines of green code in a dark editor. A young man in a hoodie clenches his fist and cheers at his screen. He then sits at a two-monitor desk in an open office, typing code with both hands. In a dark room a whole team stands in front of a wall of monitors filled with code. When a huge green check mark appears on the central screen, the whole team throws their arms up and cheers.

transcript: Ooh, nice. This one. Perfect. Love it. Ta-da!
what_is_seen: A young woman with curly hair draws a swirling logo letter on a tablet with a stylus at a sunny desk. She then stands over a table fanned out with dozens of colour swatch cards and smiles at the camera. At an iMac she arranges a colourful poster layout with a colour wheel open beside it. A hand turns a sketchbook page showing a pencil drawing of a woman in a long flowing gown. Finally she poses in front of a huge colourful mural in a gallery while visitors look at it.

A young woman standing in a crowd stares upward and points one finger at the sky; the people beside her raise their arms and point at the same spot; the camera pulls back over an old city square where hundreds of people all point straight up together.

A hiker in a cap and backpack climbs down a red rock canyon trail; the camera looks along his boots as he steps from ledge to ledge, then opens onto huge layered sandstone cliffs and a thin stony path winding down into the gorge between the rock walls.

In a bright white photo studio a young woman spins around on a black office chair, laughing; two people beside her point and turn; the camera rises to show dozens of people turning and stepping on a large circular white platform ringed with potted plants, sofas and stools.

A dense crowd stands on a paved city plaza in the evening sun; as the camera lifts, the crowd resolves into two enormous lines of people standing directly across from one another on either side of a wide empty strip of pavement that runs down the whole avenue between office buildings.

transcript: Close it in. See you later.
what_is_seen: Gardeners in straw hats and work gloves lift large flat rectangular sheets of glass into a metal frame standing over a flower bed; sheet after sheet is slotted in side by side until the frame is completely clad, and the camera flies up through the trees to show a huge glass dome in the forest.

Four shots of long structures reaching out over a distance. A workman in a blue shirt holds a telescopic aluminium ladder that pulls out to full length in front of a wooden fence. A red fire engine in a city street has its aerial ladder run out high into the sky. A crane boom stretches diagonally across a hazy construction site at sunset. Last, two steel bridge arches reach out from opposite cliffs across a red rock canyon with a river far below.

A garden party set-up on a mown lawn behind a wooden fence. First a colourful inflatable bouncy castle stands on the grass. Then a white party tent with window panels stands square on the lawn, its cloth roof stretched over a centre pole and weighted at the foot. A purple and yellow inflatable arch stands over the grass, then sags and folds flat as the air goes out of it, and a large inflatable slide collapses in the same way.

Four shots of things shaking. A phone with a cracked screen buzzes on the boards of a wooden deck. A massage gun is pressed against a man's bare bicep and hammers into the muscle. A tracked machine's hydraulic breaker punches into gravel and asphalt, throwing up small stones. Finally a big black club speaker box hangs in a dark venue with dancers behind it, and a glass of water on the table in front of it ripples with the bass.

Four shots of things being bent into a curve. Two hands hold a flexible white plastic strip over a wooden table and bow it into an S shape. Then two hands grip a thick grey branch of an apple tree, leaves attached, and pull it into an arc over a green garden. In a bright gym a girl in a leotard arches backwards until her hands reach the floor. Last, a heavy hydraulic press in a workshop presses a steel beam into a curve.

Five friends are on a sunny rooftop terrace with a city skyline behind them. Two of them laugh with an arm laid across the other's back, hand resting where the neck meets the arm. The group lines up side by side, each one's arm hooked over the next one's upper body, and walks forward together; a low shot catches their trainers on the tiles. They pull into a tight circle with hands on each other's backs, then line up again and jump into the air with their arms flung up.

A low camera close to the boards shows two two-wheeled pedal vehicles rolling side by side along a wooden seaside pier, a young man and a young woman pedalling and laughing above them. They hold the camera at arm's length for a selfie with the beach and palm trees behind. They get off, and on the pier she spins and he catches her; they hold each other by the railing, then stand together grinning at the camera with the sun setting over the sea.

Two players in padded red and blue overalls and full-face masks face off on a sandy paintball field littered with spent capsules. They bump fists, then sprint apart behind paint-splattered wooden barriers. The red player crouches behind a board holding a paintball marker, then leans out, points the marker and fires. A pink burst of paint explodes across the blue player's chest; he drops to his knees with his hands up while the red player walks past with the marker at his side.

transcript: All right, do you mind if I just go up and shoot?
spoken_sentences: All right, do you mind if I just go up and shoot?
what_is_seen: A campus club fair on a lawn: rows of tents, bunting and a stall under a red canopy with a hand-lettered sign. Three students with cameras hanging round their necks stand behind the stall table and wave a newcomer over. One of them holds out an old silver film camera; she takes it and raises it to her eye. In close-up a hand signs a form headed MEMBERSHIP on a clipboard with a blue pen. The three then lift their cameras over their heads and cheer.

A schoolgirl in a grey jumper and white collar sits at a desk in a classroom writing in a spiral notebook with a pencil, other pupils working behind her and a whiteboard at the front. She puts her hand up, beams, and slaps a high five with a hand reaching in from off camera. A close-up shows her carrying on writing a list of lines down the page. An adult hand then presses a large gold glitter star sticker onto the finished page beside her writing. In the final shot she holds the open notebook up to the camera with both hands, the gold star on the page, laughing with delight.

A woman in a checked tweed blazer and black trousers walks past a wooden lectern into a large panelled lecture hall with a full audience, a leather case in her hand. In close-up her hand draws a wide chalk arc on a green blackboard. She then stands at the board beside a big chalk drawing of a circle with a cross of axes and labelled arrows pointing outwards, touching it with a wooden pointer as she speaks. Another close-up shows her chalking a formula with a fraction and arrows next to the drawing. At the end she faces the hall with both arms spread wide, smiling, the labelled circle drawing behind her.

A woman in a pilot's uniform walks through a sunlit airport terminal pulling a silver suitcase. In the cockpit a hand reaches up to the overhead panel of switches. She then lifts a green headset with a microphone boom over her ears and settles it on her head under her cap. From behind, she flies the plane down the runway, and finally she faces the camera wearing the headset and gives a thumbs up.

A cook in a white jacket and tall white hat works in a professional restaurant kitchen: steel counters, a row of gas burners, shelves of pots, a knife rack and bottles of oil on the wall behind her. She tosses a pan over a burner and a tall flame rises; she drops green herbs into peppers and prawns frying in the pan; at the pass she arranges the food on a white plate with tweezers, tastes the sauce from a spoon, then looks up and speaks to the camera.

A young man in a dark blue dress uniform walks out of the sliding doors of an airport arrivals hall with a large black duffel bag slung over his shoulder. He grins and looks around, walks through the bright glass concourse past waiting travellers, and reaches a family holding a hand-coloured WELCOME HOME sign. He hugs the father while the mother and a young woman laugh and cheer, then lifts his peaked cap off his head as they crowd around him.

In a mirrored dance studio a young woman in a bright red crop top and short red skirt stands facing the camera with both hands planted on either side of her body just below her waist. Around her a young man in a grey T-shirt and black shorts and two other dancers copy the same position, hands flat on the sides of their bodies below the waist. The man steps up beside her, holds the pose with a serious face, and by the end both of them are laughing while the class keeps its hands in place.

A price-ladder tour of homes. An old man in a cardigan stands at a garden gate and waves toward a battered wooden hut behind him, caption 10,000 EUR. Cut to a young couple walking up the path of a detached white suburban house with a black door and a mown front lawn. Cut to a woman in a cream suit opening the door of a modern architect house, then presenting a huge glass villa with a long black reflecting pool and fountain, caption 5,000,000 EUR.

In a busy public office a young woman with long red hair stands at a service counter, gasps with excitement and picks up a small plastic card that has just been issued to her. She turns it over, reads it, then holds it up beside her face so the photo on the card and her own face are seen together, gives a thumbs up, and the people waiting behind her clap.

An open-plan office full of desks, monitors and desk phones: a man in a blue shirt coughs into his hand at his desk, a colleague standing behind him coughs too, a woman at another desk looks unwell while a colleague reaches over with a pen, and further down the room two more women blow their noses into tissues at their screens while everyone else keeps working.

In a glass-walled meeting room high above the city a woman in a black suit stands at a whiteboard covered in coloured sticky notes and talks her colleagues through her work while they sit around a table full of laptops. One after another they cut in: a man raises a finger, others lean forward and talk over her, and she raises her voice to keep going. Then a young man walks in behind her with a tray of takeaway coffees, the whole table turns to the coffee, and she leans on the table looking defeated.

An elderly woman in a flowery apron winds a sheet of pasta dough through a hand-cranked pasta machine in a rustic kitchen, with cut strips drying on a rack below. She then stirs a big red pot of meat and tomato sauce with a long wooden spoon, blows on it and tastes it, drops in a basil leaf, and finally carries the finished dish out to a long wooden table where a whole family claps and cheers.

A woman in denim dungarees with a lanyard round her neck opens a brass letterbox set into a stone wall and takes a key out of it. She turns the key in the brass plate of a tall black door, then holds up a huge ring of old keys and picks through them. She fits another key into an ornate wooden door with a heavy iron handle, turns it, and pushes the double doors open onto a sunlit garden path with ivy-covered walls.

In a rustic kitchen with painted pottery on wooden shelves, a young woman in an apron and an older woman in a headscarf stand at a floured wooden table. They push and fold a large pale mass of bread dough with their hands, laughing together, until it is shaped into a smooth round loaf on the flour-dusted table.

An outdoor tea party on a lawn in front of parkland. A young woman in a long pale floral Regency dress and a straw bonnet, her hair in ringlets, stands at a laid table, then sits and pours tea from a white porcelain teapot into painted cups. She passes a plate of scones with jam across the table to a man in a jacket who wipes his hands on a linen napkin, and at the end she raises her teacup with the others and smiles into the camera.

A woman in teal running kit and a pink cap props one leg on a wooden railing on the Great Wall and stretches at sunrise. She then sets off up the long stone staircase, running at a steady even rhythm, breathing hard, with the watchtower and hills behind her and a few walkers far below.

At a flea market on a cobbled Flemish square a woman in a rust jacket holds up a big brass table lamp, then squats down and heaves a wooden crate full of vinyl records up onto a cargo bike. Next she and another person lift a large mustard-yellow velvet armchair with padded arm supports onto the same bike, on top of the crate, and she claps and laughs at the loaded bike.

transcript: God, save that for the camera.
spoken_sentences: God, save that for the camera.
what_is_seen: A montage of people taking in sounds. A young man in a sunlit room wears big over-ear headphones, eyes closed and smiling as music plays. Two women sit over coffee in a cafe, one talking with her hand at her temple while the other leans in towards her. A man in a blue shirt presses the side of his face and a cupped hand against a closed office door in a corridor, eyes wide. Finally a festival crowd stands in front of a lit stage at dusk, some of them pressing their hands over their ears.

An evening in a family living room. A young man sits on a grey corner sofa with a remote control in his hand, laughing at the television, while other people move around in the kitchen behind him. A red-haired woman runs in and flops down beside him, and a young man in a blue T-shirt sits down with a big bowl of popcorn. A woman brings a thick blue blanket over and spreads it across all four of them, and they settle in shoulder to shoulder under it, eating popcorn and watching the screen. A wall clock, a lamp, a picture and the kitchen are visible behind the sofa.

Outdoors on a sunny day, a big man in a bright floral shirt swings a heavy duffel bag onto his shoulder, then leans hard into a luggage trolley loaded with three suitcases and a cool box and shoves it along the road. At a silver van he heaves case after case into the boot until it is crammed full, shuts it, and turns to the camera grinning and out of breath.

A young man films himself walking through a busy Turkish street market. He holds an orange up to the camera and grins, then passes a fishmonger working beside large hanging scale pans over trays of iced fish. He walks on past barrels of green olives carrying a mesh bag of oranges, and finally walks down the long vaulted aisle of a covered spice bazaar, with rows of stalls piled high with coloured spices on both sides of him.

A young man stands at an outdoor fruit stand in front of a mosque and picks up an orange while the vendor in an apron stacks more oranges behind him. He moves on to an olive stall and takes one single olive from a big metal tray to taste it, chewing and reacting to the flavour. He then walks through a covered spice bazaar past rows of coloured spice mounds and holds up his mesh bag of oranges to the camera.

In a bright mattress showroom with rows of beds along a window wall, a young woman in colourful sportswear sits on the edge of a bare mattress and pulls a pained face, then lies back on it laughing. She stands up and talks to the camera, and finally throws herself backwards onto a large mattress, arms and legs spread wide, staring up at the ceiling.

A young man with a backpack holds his card against the reader at a gym turnstile; a green tick lights up and he walks through into the gym. The clip cuts to a library chess club, where a smiling elderly woman arrives at a table of chess boards, sits down, and the other players wave, make a move on the board and applaud her as one of them.

At a night-time street food stand a cook in a checked shirt and white apron shaves slices of roasted pork off a tall vertical spit topped with a pineapple, letting them fall onto the hot griddle. He warms a tortilla on the plate, piles the shredded pork onto it with red salsa, showers it with chopped onion and coriander, and then holds out a plate of three finished tacos to the customer with his arms spread wide.

A young woman in an embroidered white blouse and jeans tours several public memorials. She crouches beside a seated bronze figure of a bearded man on a stone plinth and points at the inscribed plaque, then stands up and takes a selfie with it while a pigeon flies past. She then stands in front of a tall stone column topped by a winged bronze figure, filming it with her phone, and finally walks across a wide plaza below a huge metal figure with outstretched arms, throwing her own arms up in the same pose.

A red-haired woman in an apron is shown through a day with her children. She lifts a laughing toddler in a pink shirt up into the air in the living room, then flips pancakes at the stove while two small girls reach up for them, then kneels on the carpet and holds a girl's leg to look at a grazed knee. At the end she hugs the children goodbye on the pavement outside a school, among other parents and children with backpacks.

In a busy gym, a very thin young man with red hair pulls up his vest sleeve and flexes his arm with a strained grimace — the arm stays narrow and bony. The clip cuts to a woman in a blue top who flexes a clearly rounded, defined bicep and smiles at the camera, and then to a huge bodybuilder in a black vest who raises both arms into a double biceps pose while two friends behind him shout him on.

A young woman with pink hair in a yellow raincoat cycles along an Amsterdam canal, laughing, with narrow gabled houses and moored boats behind her. She then walks away from the camera through a tulip field with her arms spread wide, a big windmill turning directly in front of her as the shot pushes in on the red and yellow rows. Finally she stands at a market stall holding a fresh stroopwafel, pulling it apart and biting into it while the waffle irons steam behind her.

In a bright consulting room a woman in a teal polo shirt and glasses sets bowls of food down on a wooden table in front of a young man in a yellow t-shirt: a bowl of spinach, tomatoes and a yellow pepper, a bowl of brown rice, a grilled fish on a plate, a bowl of mixed nuts and a tall glass of milk. A food pyramid poster hangs on the wall behind them. She points at the food and talks him through it; he leans in, looks at each dish and nods, and she puts a hand on his shoulder as they finish.

Inside a wooden birdwatching hide, four people crowd at the open window looking out over a shallow lake. An older man with a white moustache bends to a spotting scope on a tripod, a young woman with green hair holds binoculars, a man beside her stares out, and someone writes in a notebook on the ledge. Outside, hundreds of tall pink birds with long legs stand in the water, and the whole flock lifts off and flies low across the lake with their pink and black wings spread.

A young travel vlogger films himself on a trip. First he walks beside a truck covered in bright hand-painted flowers with a peacock painted on its side, and puts his hand on it. Then he stands at a wooden railing under strings of prayer flags, looking out at a snow-covered mountain range lit orange by the sun above a deep valley. Finally, on a city rooftop at sunset with domes and minarets behind him, he holds a string and flies a red kite while dozens of coloured kites fill the sky around him.

In a sunny park a group of young people play a freeze game on the grass. A man in a white t-shirt stands rigid with his eyes wide and his mouth open. A woman in black bounces towards the camera with her mouth wide open, crying out. Another man throws both hands up and shouts with his mouth wide open. The whole group then dances together on the lawn, one of them drops flat onto the grass, and the man in white cries out and laughs into the camera.

A young woman in a mustard beanie climbs the steps into a train while a member of staff helps lift her hard-shell suitcase; another train and travellers with luggage are on the platform behind her. Inside, she walks down the narrow carriage corridor holding her ticket, heaves the suitcase onto the overhead rack, then sits by the window and watches the platform and rails slide past as the train pulls away.

A young man in an airport holds an open passport towards the camera and fans the pages: every page is plain white, with nothing on it. He grins, then hands the passport across an immigration counter where an officer's stamp and a screen sit. Later, at a table, he opens the same passport to show pages now crowded with coloured entry stamps and visas, before flicking through it again.

A young man with a red, sore nose stands at a lit pharmacy window under a green cross sign while a hand behind the glass passes him a small box of medicine. He then waits inside a modern pharmacy under a red digital queue-number display, carrying a paper bag, and pays at a self-service terminal. Finally he stands open-mouthed inside a grand old pharmacy whose walls are floor-to-ceiling wooden drawers, watching a pharmacist in a white coat climb a tall wooden ladder to fetch something from the top row.

A young man in a dark red bomber jacket walks into a small pharmacy past a lit green cross. At the counter he holds out a folded white slip of paper to the pharmacist in a white coat, who reads it, turns to the wall of medicine boxes behind her and picks out the packet the paper asks for. She comes back and hands him the medicine across the glass counter, and he takes it and smiles.

Two young people work outdoors in a sunny hillside garden, bent over a long raised wooden bed filled with dark soil. He presses small green seedlings into the soil one by one while she loosens the earth beside him with a hand trowel, and a row of identical seedlings appears down the length of the bed. A wide shot shows several parallel raised beds, one of them already planted, and the two of them stepping back with their tools to look at the finished rows.

A young man with bleached hair crouches in a dark room and flicks a wall switch, then pushes a black cable into the back of a Samsung monitor, plugs another into a Nintendo Switch dock, and pushes a plug into the front of a PC tower while tidying the cables behind the desk. The monitor lights up with a blue wallpaper, the room glows purple, and he sits back in the gaming chair looking at the finished setup.

A young man in glasses and a cardigan sits at a metal cafe table by the sea, writing on the back of a picture postcard with a blue biro; a stamp lies on the table beside it. He then stands at a rotating rack of postcards on a village street, turning it and pulling out a fan of cards. Finally he stands at a yellow street postbox, holds the postcard to his lips, pushes it through the slot and pats the box.

At an outdoor dinner table at dusk a young woman in a bright patterned dress pours orange juice from a glass jug into tall glasses while older relatives sit around the loaded table, laughing and clapping; she finally lifts the jug high over her head and pours a long stream into a glass.

A woman in paint-spattered dungarees and a headband paints the last strokes of a huge mural of suns and waves on a city wall from a stepladder, then climbs down, backs onto the pavement and stands with her hands on her hips, looking up at the finished painting and smiling.

Heavy rain on a city street. A frail elderly man in a dark jacket stands soaked, clutching a paper bag with two baguettes in it. A young person in a black raincoat steps in behind him and holds a big yellow umbrella over his head, taking all the rain themselves, then puts an arm around his shoulders. Water pours off the umbrella. The two walk on together under it and the old man smiles.

In a sunny kitchen a young woman in an apron and a green headscarf works through a handwritten page step by step. She leans over it and points at a line, chops cherry tomatoes on a board, tips them into a big bowl of cut vegetables, holds the page up and reads the next step, pours olive oil over the salad, then lays the page flat on the worktop and smiles at the finished bowl.

Under the glass roof of a big railway station a family waits on the platform: a father in a cap, a mother in tears and a teenage son holding up a hand-drawn welcome sign, trains standing at the platforms behind them. A young woman with a rucksack and a duffel bag comes running out through the Arrivals doorway, drops her bag and throws herself into their arms. The four of them stand hugging on the platform, crying and laughing.

A hiker with a rucksack traces a red line across a laminated map with her finger, checks a trail information board at the edge of a forest, runs up a dusty path past a boulder painted with a red-and-white waymark, then climbs a long flight of stone steps built into the mountainside, and at the top holds the map up to the camera and points at the line she has just walked.

A woman in a red headband stands at a trail map board in a pine forest and raises a finger as if fixing the way in her head, then runs along a dusty forest trail past a large pale boulder, places a stone on a cairn at the top, and finally stands at a viewpoint above a wide green valley holding an open map with a red line drawn on it.

A heavy-set king in a gold crown and a crimson fur-trimmed cape sits on a carved wooden throne in a stone castle hall, holding a golden sceptre; servants carry a tray of goblets and food to him past armoured guards. Musicians in doublets sit on the steps below his throne playing lutes and a drum for him. The shot then cuts to a vast cathedral seen from behind the throne, where hundreds of people in medieval dress line the nave and, in the last seconds, all bow low to him at once.

A woman in an orange race vest with a number bib runs along a grey waterfront promenade on a cold overcast day. She takes a white paper cup, drinks from it while still running, then glances down at the watch on her wrist. In the last seconds she comes down the closed-off finishing straight past an orange cone, spectators packed behind metal barriers clapping her in, and crosses the blue finish line with her arms lifted, a second runner far behind her.

A woman in a fur-flapped hat and a burgundy winter coat stands with her arms spread wide in a snowy square in front of a cathedral with coloured onion domes. She is then on a train, holding a glass of black tea in a metal holder and sipping it while snow-covered birch woods slide past the window. Finally she is at an evening winter market strung with fairy lights, smiling as she twists open a small painted wooden doll and holds up the two halves and the smaller doll from inside it.

A falconry clip in the desert at dusk. A young man in a white thobe and a red-checked headscarf swings a lure on a long cord over his head. A falcon flies in low across the sand, beats its wings and drops onto his raised gloved fist, spreading both wings wide as it settles. He laughs, then feeds it small pieces of meat from his fingers. Friends and a pickup truck stand behind him, and camp tents sit among the dunes.

A young woman in a coral jacket rides a stand-up electric scooter along a sunlit seaside promenade, grinning at the camera with the blue sea and a stone breakwater behind her. She then stands beside a long rank of parked rental e-scooters at the water's edge, tapping her phone; a close-up over her shoulder shows the rental app open on the screen with a circular logo and a blue button. Finally a wide shot shows a palm-lined promenade with a dozen people riding hired e-scooters past the trees.

A man in a dark suit sits at a polished wooden desk in a grand hall with EU and French flags behind him and writes a looping signature on a sheet of paper with a gold fountain pen. He works through a tall stack of pages, lifting each one as he signs. Then two aides unroll an enormous roll of paper the whole length of the table, and while photographers film he leans over it and signs it with an oversized pen.

Outside a wooden mountain hut, a young man in an embroidered folk shirt, leather belt and a black felt hat with a feather cooks an old country dish over a fire. He scrapes small dumplings off a wooden board into a big black cauldron of boiling water, holds up a white lump of sheep cheese, sprinkles fried bacon over the pot and stirs it with a wooden spoon. He then serves the finished dish in a carved wooden bowl on a rough wooden table and grins at the camera while hikers watch from the hut behind him.

A boy stands with his father at the open bonnet of a car in a bright garage; the father hands him a spanner and both grin. The same boy is then hugged tight by his mother in a white kitchen, kicks a football back and forth with his father on the driveway, and finally plays with other children on a park lawn while the parents watch.

In the paved yard behind a low house at sunset, a young man in a green rugby shirt grills a long coiled sausage on a round charcoal kettle. Flames leap up over a row of meat skewers, he lifts a browned piece with tongs and turns to the camera laughing while friends stand around the yard with drinks.

A man and a woman, both wearing wedding rings, walk together down the hallway of a house carrying a paper grocery bag between them. In the kitchen they stand side by side at a wooden counter, each signing an official-looking document with a blue pen and smiling at each other's page. They high-five in the hallway, then walk to the front door hand in hand.

On a wet London street a young woman's sheets of paper are scattered across the road; a young man kneels down, gathers them up and hands them back, and she smiles at him. Later, at a bus stop in the rain, an older man in a suit holds his umbrella over her head and points out the right bus. A red double-decker pulls in, and as she steps aboard she turns back, waves and thanks him while he keeps the umbrella up.

A ceremonial hall hung with flags: a silver-haired woman in a dark dress uniform and white gloves pins a decoration onto the chest of a young man in black tie, while a rank of soldiers in dress uniform stands to one side. She moves along the line to the next man and pins a medal on him too. The camera then pulls back to reveal the man she is decorating: his whole chest and stomach are plated with hundreds of medals and ribbons in overlapping rows, from collar to waist. He beams and laughs as she adds one more.

transcript: That's the spot. Mmm, that feels good. So good.
what_is_seen: A group workout on a park lawn at golden hour, big trees behind and low sun flaring through the leaves. A woman in a grey crop top stands at the front with both arms stretched overhead, hands clasped, leaning to one side, and half a dozen people in gym clothes behind her copy the move. They drop into deep kneeling lunges with a hand on the front knee, then all jump on the spot swinging their arms up over their heads, then settle into wide side lunges with both arms held straight out, everyone moving together.

An exhausted female runner wearing race bib 134 is held up under both arms by a man in a grey cap and a young woman in a rainbow tri-suit at the end of a city road race. Spectators behind metal barriers clap and shout. The three walk her forward together across the finish line, then stop and fall into a tight group hug, crying and laughing.

A cardboard box with FREE STUFF written on the side stands on a low garden wall in a quiet suburban street. A cyclist in a racing jersey and helmet reaches in and lifts a table lamp out of it. A bearded man in a hoodie reaches in and lifts out an American football. An elderly woman with a walking stick lifts out a terracotta plant pot. Finally a young man with a backpack looks into the empty box, picks up the box itself and carries it away down the pavement.

transcript: No way! No way! No way! Is that so?
what_is_seen: At a long cafe table on a sunlit Italian piazza, a grey-haired woman in glasses turns to the young man beside her and makes a point with both hands while he answers her back. More friends arrive and sit down along the same table of espresso cups and water glasses, and each of them joins in, leaning forward, putting a view to the others and answering what is said, until the whole table is turned in towards the middle, gesturing and laughing.

A group in matching yellow shirts huddles in a tight circle on a blue outdoor volleyball court, heads together, psyching each other up. They break and play: one dives flat to dig the ball, another jumps at the net and smashes it over, the opposing players jump to block. The rally ends in their favour and the whole squad runs together into one big hug, jumping and shouting under palm trees and a bright blue sky.

transcript: Nope. Was always one step ahead. All good.
what_is_seen: In a living room a tall young man in a band T-shirt holds a big orange packet of crisps high above his head, out of reach, mouth open in mock shock. A young woman in a football kit stretches up and grabs for it; he keeps swinging the packet away and laughing while she circles him. She finally gets both hands on it, walks off with it, and sits on the sofa holding the packet open and eating from it.

Handheld phone footage at a sunny skatepark and the adjoining basketball court. A boy in a dark hooded sweatshirt rides a skateboard across the concrete and steps off; another boy stands watching him from the far side of the bowl while more boys wait on the grass. Three boys shoot a basketball at an outdoor hoop. Then about ten teenage boys in hoodies and caps press into a tight ring around one phone, pointing at the screen, shouting and laughing, a backpack lying on the grass at their feet.

A baby in a striped bodysuit stands on a fluffy living-room rug and takes wobbly first steps towards two adults who kneel a few feet away, clapping and cheering it on. The film cuts to a bright daycare room where several small children in T-shirts toddle unsteadily between coloured foam blocks, and then to a wide view of the same room full of little children walking around low tables and small chairs.

A man in an olive jacket with a backpack walks off a metro train onto the platform among other passengers, then jogs along a sunny street towards a red and cream tram and steps up through its open door. He then runs across a stone quay past flying seagulls towards the water, where a white passenger boat with a small wheelhouse and an open deck is moored. He walks up the metal gangway and steps aboard the boat.

A young man in a red beanie and a checked shirt sits on a park bench and squashes a piece of rubbish into a ball in his hands, then drops it into a round steel park bin beside the bench. He walks on past a big green metal dumpster on a city pavement, looking back at the camera. In a wide open square he throws a piece of rubbish in a high arc towards a long row of colour-coded bins, each marked with a recycling symbol, and watches it fly in.

transcript: I'm shaking. So nervous. I can't.
what_is_seen: In a dark theatre lit by warm lamps, a laughing young woman holds a cream envelope up to the camera; the flap is closed with a round red wax seal pressed with a stamp. A young man in a green hoodie then shakes his hands in front of his chest and pulls a wide-eyed, nervous face. The shot cuts to a group of young people on a lit stage who jump, scream, hug each other and celebrate.

In a bright sports hall, a blonde woman in black training clothes stands on a wooden plyo box with her arms folded and her eyes shut. A group of men and women in gym gear form two facing lines below her and stretch their arms out with their palms up, hands interlocked. She lets herself fall straight backwards without looking; the group catches her in their linked hands and lowers her gently. Everyone laughs and claps and she grins.

A young man in a yellow kurta walks backwards through a house at dusk, filming himself. He stops at a wall switch inside the veranda and flips it, then walks out into the garden past potted plants and palm trees to a switch box on a pole. He flips that one too and strings of fairy lights come on all across the house front, the palms and the garden, turning the blue evening bright. He looks up at the lights and grins.

A woman in a red embroidered apron makes dumplings on a big wooden table in a log kitchen. A white bowl of dark red fruit filling stands at her elbow next to a lump of dough and a row of flat dough circles; she takes each circle, closes it around a spoonful of the filling and presses the edge shut, laying the finished half-moons out in rows across the table. She carries a full board of them to a wide black pan of boiling water over an open fire while a small boy in an embroidered shirt watches, tastes one from a spoon over the steaming pan, and finally sets a wooden bowl of cooked dumplings on the table beside the bowl of red filling.

In a bright clinic waiting room a nurse in a white coat holds up a small glass vial and shows it to a young man in a green t-shirt sitting on a chair. She swabs his upper arm and pushes the needle of a syringe into it while he watches and smiles. A round plaster is stuck on the spot, and he stands up and flexes his bicep proudly while other patients wait in the background.

A young man in a grey wool coat stands at the rail of a ship pulling away from a harbour town of red and white houses and waves back at the shore. Out on open grey water he wedges himself against the mast, opens a small black hardback book and writes in it with a blue pen, smiling as the waves break past. Later, in golden evening light, he stands at the white rail writing in the same book while the ship passes tall sea cliffs topped by a lighthouse, then looks up from the page in amazement.

In a fabric shop lined with stacked bolts of cloth and a wall of coloured thread spools, a smiling young woman in a rust-orange jumpsuit stands while an older man with a yellow tape measure runs it around the narrow middle of her body and reads the number. The shot moves in close on her middle as she fastens a wide woven red belt around it. She then steps back and spins a hula hoop around the same part of her body, laughing with her arms raised, a sewing machine and workbench behind her.

A selfie-stick shot of a young woman with pink-tipped hair and a bearded man crossing a wide Japanese city intersection at dusk. Filling the buildings behind and above them are huge illuminated advertising boards - stacked panels of neon lettering, brand logos and lit-up product pictures running up the facades on every side. The two walk towards the camera across the striped crossing with a dense crowd of people behind them; she pulls a wide-eyed, delighted face at the lens.

A young man in a paint-spattered t-shirt is decorating a bare white wall in a flat with a wooden floor. He holds a black-framed picture up against the wall and shifts it until it sits straight, then lays a yellow spirit level along the top edge of a framed flower painting and watches the bubble. He hangs a striped woven textile beside the frames, adds two wooden shelves with potted plants and a decorative leaf clock, and by the end the whole wall is a dense gallery of aligned frames. A step ladder stands to one side and he steps back, hands on hips, to look at the finished wall.

On a small balcony crowded with plants at sunset, a green plastic watering can pours a fan of water over pots of orange and pink marigolds and young rosemary plants. An elderly woman with grey hair in a floral blouse holds the can up with both hands and moves it along the hanging baskets and pot plants, smiling as the water sprays out of the long spout onto the leaves.

A bright living room with white curtains and a pale floor. A young woman in a purple sports bra and leggings squats with her arms held straight out in front of her, then drops onto a teal exercise mat and pushes up into a high plank with a phone timer and a water bottle on the floor beside her. She lowers onto her forearms into an elbow plank and holds it, face tight with effort as the timer counts up. At the end she drops flat onto her back on the mat, arms spread, breathing hard.
